order: fixed case order; alternate which arm runs first for each case
stages: real catalog retrieval and existing-document selection
production assembled bound review and controller canonical validation
at most one proposal repair and re-review
baseline: Methodology-only existing-document selection and prior hypothesis evaluator input assembly. Current native schemas and semantic rules.
candidate: Task-local existing-document selection and dedicated hypothesis review packet. Failed presentation changes remain reverted.
metrics: baseline and controlled variation actually executed
grading: Correct expected classification plus valid cited observation IDs including policy, permitted baseline and boundary variation. Fixture truth is hidden from model inputs. Delivery receipts alone do not count as adoption.
failure_policy: Persist failures and capped/incomplete cases; no selective reruns or prompt tuning after first live request.
safety: HTTP and TCP are loopback only. Redirects never followed. Filesystem probes are confined to owned temporary fixture markers. Tool inputs use only declared values. No active operation store or global catalog writes.
exclusions: automatic lead matching and delivery hooks
deployment: Diagnostic only. Earlier failed promotion gates remain failed. No automatic deployment regardless of results.
